premises.text: In-car technology goes outdated quickly and can only be refreshed by buying a new car, leaving more than a billion vehicles on the road behind OEM/Apple/Google new-car approaches
premises.evidence_span: the only way to change that is to buy a new car

premises.text: A plug-in Vinly connected-car device and app catalog make post-1996 cars smarter with day-one consumer apps for safety, savings, and fun
premises.evidence_span: VINLY is a connected car platform that enables building applications and services for your car

premises.text: Consumer Vinly hardware is sold at $49.99 basic or $149.99 complete with Bluetooth, LTE, hotspot, and advanced crash reporting
premises.evidence_span: $49.99 for our vinly basic device, at $149.99 for our vinly complete

premises.text: Enterprises can plug Vinly into fleets and run customizable business apps such as Fleet Tracker for $149.99 per year including device and data
premises.evidence_span: companies can buy Vinly devices, plug it into their fleet, and start using business applications

premises.text: Developers can build connected-car apps for any make and model through a simplified car API plus Backpack, SDKs, sim kits, analytics, and docs
premises.evidence_span: developers can build applications for the connected car, regardless of their make and model, because we simplified the complicated car into a simple API call

domains.name: outdated car technology on existing vehicles

value.text: Existing cars become smarter than new assembly-line cars via apps and services without buying a new vehicle
value.evidence_span: smarter than a car that just left the assembly line

secondary_value.text: Developers can make money building for a huge connected-car market
secondary_value.evidence_span: We want to help you make money

secondary_value.text: Businesses can take fleets to the next level
secondary_value.evidence_span: We can take your fleet to the next level

download the Vinly app catalog and start using apps right away
Fleet Tracker, which enables them to manage and track their fleet

notes: Safety/money/fun consumer apps folded as day-one catalog cascade of the device platform (§4.1.7). Developer Backpack/SDK/analytics toolkit folded into the open-API developer premise. Pricing kept with consumer hardware as same-offer commercial detail (§4.1.3); enterprise annual fleet package split as separately sold segment. Market-size and one-day traction excluded (§4.2).
